name: Window Memory
description:
Remembers where every window was and puts it back, like Windows and macOS do.

• Reopened apps come back at the same position and size, on the same monitor, maximized if they were
• Positions are remembered separately for each monitor setup (docked, undocked, a monitor turned off…)
• When a monitor sleeps, wakes, is unplugged or plugged back in, windows go back to where they were instead of piling onto one screen
